item.title: Retirees express concerns about Social Security's future
item.description: Clients worry Social Security may not be available. The advice offered is not to let that fear lead to a smaller check.

item.title: Rural Pennsylvania data center dispute reflects broader bipartisan fight over AI
item.description: NorthPoint Development's $10,000 offer to Hazle Township residents for data center approval has become a new flashpoint in the debate over AI infrastructure.

item.title: Gen Z moves to California as older Americans leave for the Sun Belt
item.description: California's population has declined since 2020, but new U-Haul data ranks it as Gen Z's second most popular destination, after Texas, citing big-city jobs and family ties.

item.title: Hispanic Heritage Month highlights stalled Fortune 500 progress
item.description: Boards celebrate leadership firsts but must also provide support for those leaders to succeed.
